_comment: English for `olla-dft wizard`. `strings` maps every user-facing Spanish string of qekit/modules/wizard.py (goal catalogue, glossary terms and definitions, fixed report strings, diagnostic templates) to English; tests/test_wizard_en.py fails if a catalogue string is missing here. Commands (`{file}` templates), goal keys and prerequisite keys are deliberately absent. `keywords` are the plain-English search words per goal, weighted like the goal's question.

strings.--- ¿Qué quieres saber? ---: --- What do you want to know? ---
strings.Se elige con: olla-dft wizard estructur: Pick one with:  olla-dft wizard estructura.cif --goal <key>
strings.O se busca con tus palabras: olla-dft w: Or search in your own words:  olla-dft wizard estructura.cif --ask "does it absorb light"
strings.--- Lo que veo en tu estructura ---: --- What I see in your structure ---
strings.Se descargan de pseudo-dojo.org o de q: Download them from pseudo-dojo.org or quantum-espresso.org/pseudopotentials,
strings.y se le dicen a Olla-DFT con: olla-df: and tell Olla-DFT where they are with:  olla-dft config set pseudo_dir /path/to/your/pseudos
strings.Hay {hueco:.1f} Å de vacío a lo largo de: There are {hueco:.1f} Å of vacuum along the {eje} axis: this looks like a slab or a monolayer, not a bulk solid.
strings.Hay metales de transición o tierras rara:
There are transition metals or rare earths ({lista}). If the material is an insulating oxide and it
comes out metallic, the problem is self-interaction: see the goal 'oxido'.
strings.Lo que has escrito puede ser varias cosa: What you wrote could mean several things. The most likely first:
strings.Te cuento la primera ({clave}); las otra: Here is the first one ({clave}); the others with --goal <key>.
strings.meta '{meta}' desconocida. Las disponibl: unknown goal '{meta}'. The available ones are listed by 'olla-dft wizard --list'.
strings.El archivo (.UPF) que sustituye al núcle: The file (.UPF) that replaces the nucleus and the core electrons of an element. Without one for each element in your structure, nothing can be computed.
strings.Hasta qué detalle se describe la función: How finely the wavefunction is described, in Ry. Higher is more accurate and more expensive. There is no universal value: it depends on the pseudopotential, and it has to be converged.
strings.Cuántos puntos del espacio recíproco se: How many points of reciprocal space are sampled. Denser is more accurate and more expensive. A metal needs a much denser one than an insulator.
strings.El cálculo básico: encuentra la densidad: The basic calculation: it finds the ground-state electron density for fixed atomic positions. Almost everything else starts from an scf.
strings.Un cálculo que reutiliza la densidad de: A calculation that reuses the density of an scf to get energies at many more k-points, without solving self-consistency again. It is what makes bands and the DOS cheap.
strings.Dejar que los átomos se muevan hasta que: Letting the atoms move until the forces are almost zero. If your structure comes from a paper or from a database with ANOTHER functional, it has to be relaxed before anything else.
strings.La distancia en energía entre el último: The energy distance between the last occupied state and the first empty one. If it is zero, the material conducts; if not, it is a semiconductor or an insulator.
strings.Densidad de estados: cuántos estados ele: Density of states: how many electronic states there are at each energy. The PDOS splits them by atom and by orbital, which is what tells you who contributes what to the bond.
strings.Las vibraciones del cristal. De ellas sa: The vibrations of the crystal. From them come the infrared and Raman spectra, the heat capacity, the thermal expansion, and the check of whether your structure is stable.
strings.Repetir la celda varias veces para meter: Repeating the cell several times to fit a defect, a dopant or a molecule without it interacting with itself through the periodicity.
strings.Espacio vacío que se deja en una direcci: Empty space left along one direction to simulate a surface or a monolayer. If there is too little, the two faces of the slab see each other.
strings.La receta de intercambio y correlación (: The exchange-correlation recipe (PBE, PZ, PBEsol...). Numbers computed with different functionals can NOT be compared with each other.
strings.Que el resultado ya no cambie al hacer e: That the result no longer changes when the calculation is made finer. It is not optional: an unconverged number is not a result.
strings.Una base localizada en el espacio real,: A basis localised in real space, obtained by transforming the Bloch bands. With it the Hamiltonian is a small matrix that decays with distance, and the band at any k-point comes from diagonalising it: microseconds instead of another DFT calculation.
strings.La fase que acumula un estado electrónic: The phase an electronic state picks up when it goes around the Brillouin zone. It sounds abstract and it is literally a position: the Wannier centres and the electric polarization come from it.
strings.Cuánta carga hay que mover para producir: How much charge has to move to produce the polarization that appears when an atom is displaced. It is not the nominal ionic charge: in a homopolar crystal like silicon it is exactly zero.
strings.La tercera derivada de la energía respec: The third derivative of the energy with respect to the atomic displacements. It is what makes phonons scatter off each other and, therefore, what makes the thermal conductivity finite.
strings.La distancia que recorre un fonón antes: The distance a phonon travels before scattering. If most of the heat is carried by long-path phonons, making the grain smaller than that distance lowers the conductivity; if not, it is useless.
strings.Medio de apantallamiento efectivo. Susti: Effective screening medium. It replaces the periodic images along the vacuum direction with an explicit boundary condition, which is what allows a charged surface to be computed without the compensating background that fills everything.
strings.La energía que cuesta arrancar un electr: The energy it costs to pull an electron out of the surface and leave it in the vacuum: the vacuum level minus the Fermi level.
strings.Cuánto voltaje de más hay que aplicar, p: How much extra voltage has to be applied, above the thermodynamic one, for an electrochemical reaction to run. It is the figure of merit of a catalyst.
strings.Cuánto se mueve una banda por unidad de: How much a band moves per unit strain. It is what relates mechanical stress to the change in the gap.
strings.Dónde caen las bandas de un material res: Where the bands of one material lie with respect to those of another when they are put in contact. It decides whether a heterojunction confines electrons and holes together (type I) or apart (type II).
strings.¿qué es esto que tengo? ¿está bien la es: what is this thing I have? is the structure right?
strings.Lee tu archivo, dice el grupo espacial,: Reads your file and reports the space group, the inequivalent sites and the distances. It is free and it is the first thing to look at: if the symmetry is not what you expected, everything else comes out wrong.
strings.Dar por buena una estructura de una base: Accepting a structure from a database without looking at it. A badly centred cell or one with an extra atom does not raise an error: it gives wrong results.
strings.¿cuáles son las posiciones y el parámetr: what are the correct positions and lattice parameter?
strings.Deja que los átomos y la celda se muevan: Lets the atoms and the cell move to the energy minimum WITH YOUR functional. An experimental structure, or one from another database, is not at the minimum of yours, and that residual stress contaminates everything else.
strings.Saltarse la convergencia. Una relajación: Skipping convergence. A relaxation with a low cutoff gives a lattice parameter that looks reasonable and is off by 2 %.
strings.¿es metal, semiconductor o aislante? ¿cu: is it a metal, a semiconductor or an insulator? what is its band gap?
strings.Calcula la energía de los electrones a l:
Computes the electron energies along the high-symmetry path. From that come the gap, whether it is direct or indirect, and where the valence band maximum and the conduction band minimum are.
WATCH OUT: DFT with PBE or LDA UNDERESTIMATES the gap, typically by 30 to 50 %. The value you get is not the experimental one, and that is not a failure of the calculation: it is a known limitation of the method.
strings.Comparar el gap calculado con el experim: Comparing the computed gap with the experimental one and concluding that the calculation is wrong. It is underestimated by construction.
strings.¿qué átomo y qué orbital aportan a cada: which atom and which orbital contribute to each part of the spectrum?
strings.La densidad de estados dice cuántos esta: The density of states says how many states there are at each energy; the PROJECTED one splits them by atom and by orbital. It is what answers 'this peak here, is it from the oxygen or from the metal?'.
strings.Usar la misma malla k que en el scf. La: Using the same k-mesh as in the scf. The DOS needs a much denser one or it comes out with spurious peaks.
strings.¿de qué color va a ser? ¿absorbe luz vis: what colour will it be? does it absorb visible light?
strings.Calcula la función dieléctrica y de ahí: Computes the dielectric function and from it the absorption, the refractive index and the reflectivity. The Tauc plot gives the optical gap, which is the one measured in a UV-Vis.
strings.epsilon.x SOLO funciona con pseudopotenc: epsilon.x ONLY works with norm-conserving pseudopotentials. With ultrasoft or PAW it gives numbers without complaining, and they are wrong.
strings.¿cómo se vería en un difractómetro de ra: what would it look like in an X-ray diffractometer?
strings.Calcula las posiciones e intensidades de: Computes the positions and intensities of the diffraction peaks from the structure. Use it to compare with your measurement and confirm that the phase is the one you think.
strings.Comparar intensidades sin tener en cuent: Comparing intensities without accounting for preferred orientation: a pressed sample does not give the intensities of an ideal powder.
strings.¿esta estructura es estable? ¿no se va a: is this structure stable? won't it fall apart?
strings.Si alguna frecuencia sale imaginaria, la: If any frequency comes out imaginary, the structure is NOT a minimum: there is a distortion that lowers the energy. It is the toughest test a proposed structure can be put through.
strings.Calcular fonones sobre una estructura ma: Computing phonons on a badly relaxed structure. The imaginary frequencies you get come from the missing relaxation, not from the material.
strings.¿es duro? ¿es frágil? ¿cuánto se deforma: is it hard? is it brittle? how much does it deform?
strings.De las Cij salen el módulo de bulk, el d: From the Cij come the bulk modulus, Young's modulus, Poisson's ratio and Pugh's criterion (brittle or ductile). Also the speed of sound and an estimate of the thermal conductivity.
strings.Deformaciones demasiado grandes: se sale: Strains that are too large: you leave the linear regime and the Cij come out wrong. And too small: it drowns in numerical noise.
strings.¿qué picos voy a ver en el Raman o en el: which peaks will I see in Raman or in the infrared?
strings.Los modos vibracionales en el punto Gamm: The vibrational modes at the Gamma point, with their intensities. In a crystal with an inversion centre, a Raman-active mode is NOT IR-active and vice versa: that mutual exclusion rule is the first check that the calculation is right.
strings.Comparar frecuencias calculadas con medi: Comparing computed frequencies with measured ones without remembering that the harmonic approximation typically overestimates by 2-5 %.
strings.¿cuánto cuesta cortar este cristal? ¿cuá: how much does it cost to cut this crystal? what is its work function?
strings.Corta una superficie con los índices que: Cuts a surface with the indices you ask for, adds vacuum, and computes the work function from the electrostatic potential.
strings.Poco vacío. Con menos de 15 Å las dos ca: Too little vacuum. With less than 15 Å the two faces of the slab see each other, and the work function comes out wrong.
strings.¿qué le pasa a mi material si le meto un: what happens to my material if I add a dopant or remove an atom?
strings.Construye la supercelda con el defecto,: Builds the supercell with the defect, and unfolds the bands to see what happened to the electronic structure of the original material — which is what cannot be seen in the folded bands of a supercell.
strings.Supercelda pequeña: el defecto ve sus pr: A small supercell: the defect sees its own images and the band you get is that of a lattice of defects, not of an isolated defect.
strings.¿es un material laminar? ¿cuánto cuesta: is it a layered material? how much does it cost to exfoliate it?
strings.Detecta las capas por conectividad, mide: Detects the layers by connectivity, measures the basal spacing and computes what it costs to separate a monolayer from the bulk.
strings.Calcular exfoliación sin corrección de d: Computing exfoliation without a dispersion correction. Plain PBE does not describe the interaction between layers and the energy comes out almost zero.
strings.¿cómo se reparte la carga? ¿quién le da: how is the charge shared? who gives electrons to whom?
strings.Cargas de Bader y de Löwdin, y la difere: Bader and Löwdin charges, and the density difference between the compound and its parts. It is what quantifies the charge transfer in a bond.
strings.Comparar cargas de Bader con cargas form: Comparing Bader charges with formal charges. They are not the same thing and need not look alike.
strings.¿sirve como termoeléctrico? ¿cuánto vale: is it any good as a thermoelectric? what is its Seebeck coefficient?
strings.Coeficiente Seebeck, conductividad y fac: Seebeck coefficient, conductivity and power factor as a function of doping and temperature. By default it uses a constant relaxation time (CRTA), which gives sigma/tau; with the electron-phonon module you get the real tau.
strings.Malla k insuficiente. El Seebeck es una: Insufficient k-mesh. The Seebeck coefficient is a derivative of the band structure and needs far more k-points than the total energy.
strings.mi material es un óxido de metal de tran: my material is a transition-metal oxide and it comes out metallic when it shouldn't
strings.El problema clásico: la DFT normal deslo: The classic problem: plain DFT over-delocalises the d and f electrons, and an insulator comes out metallic. DFT+U fixes it, but it needs a U parameter — which almost everybody copies from a paper. Here it is computed for YOUR system.
strings.Usar un U de la literatura calculado con: Using a U from the literature computed with ANOTHER projection scheme. It is not the same number.
strings.¿se adsorbe esta molécula? ¿cuál es la b: does this molecule adsorb? what is the reaction barrier?
strings.La energía de adsorción electrónica, la: The electronic adsorption energy, the barrier along the reaction path, and the thermal corrections needed to compare them with an experiment.
strings.Dar la barrera electrónica como energía: Reporting the electronic barrier as the activation energy. Without zero-point energy or entropy it can be more than 0.5 eV away from the measured one.
strings.¿qué le pasa a este átomo en concreto? ¿: what happens to this particular atom? which oxidation state is it in?
strings.Dos espectroscopías que miran UN átomo:: Two spectroscopies that look at ONE atom: the core-level shifts (XPS) and the X-ray absorption near the edge (XANES). Both need a core-hole pseudopotential, which Olla-DFT generates.
strings.Un pseudopotencial con hueco de core NO: A core-hole pseudopotential does NOT come in the standard tables. Without it, XPS returns a table of zeros without raising an error.
strings.¿cómo se mueven los átomos? ¿difunde alg: how do the atoms move? does anything diffuse?
strings.De una trayectoria salen la función de d: From a trajectory come the radial distribution function (structure), the mean squared displacement (diffusion) and the vibrational density of states, the latter including anharmonicity.
strings.Analizar el equilibrado. Los primeros pi: Analysing the equilibration. The first picoseconds are not the equilibrium trajectory and they bias everything.
strings.quiero poner un material sobre otro: I want to put one material on top of another
strings.Busca la supercelda común que hace que l: Finds the common supercell that makes the two lattices match with the least strain, and builds the stack.
strings.Aceptar la celda más pequeña sin mirar l: Accepting the smallest cell without looking at the strain. Above 3 % you are no longer modelling your material.
strings.quiero comparar dos materiales o dos cál: I want to compare two materials or two calculations with each other
strings.Antes de restar dos energías hay que est: Before subtracting two energies you have to be sure they are comparable: same functional, same pseudopotentials, same cutoffs, same occupations. Subtracting incomparable energies is the most expensive mistake in DFT because it gives no warning.
It is the mistake itself: comparing without auditing.
strings.¿qué le pasa al material si lo estiro o: what happens to the material if I stretch or compress it?
strings.Aplica deformaciones controladas y sigue:
Applies controlled strains and follows the gap, the energy and the moment. From that come the deformation potential, the biaxial modulus and, if the gap crosses zero, the strain at which the material turns metallic.
Not to be confused with relaxing: here the strain is IMPOSED and held; it is what happens in a film grown on another substrate.
strings.Comparar el gap de dos deformaciones con: Comparing the gap of two strains with a different number of bands. If nbnd changes, the LUMO may not be there and the gap comes out made up.
strings.voy a poner dos materiales en contacto:: I am going to put two materials in contact: where do their bands end up?
strings.Da los desplazamientos ΔE_v y ΔE_c y el:
Gives the offsets ΔE_v and ΔE_c and the heterojunction type (I, II or III), which is what decides whether the pair is good for an LED, for a solar cell or for nothing.
WATCH OUT: the valence band maxima of two different calculations are NOT comparable as they are. Each cell has its own arbitrary energy zero. They have to be referred to the vacuum or to the macroscopic potential of the interface, and that is exactly what this command does.
strings.Restar los VBM crudos de dos cálculos. C: Subtracting the raw VBMs of two calculations. Changing only the vacuum from 16 to 22 Å moves the VBM of hBN by 0.60 eV without any change in the physics.
strings.quiero la banda en cualquier punto k sin: I want the band at any k-point without running DFT again
strings.Baja la estructura de bandas a un modelo:
Brings the band structure down to a small model in real space. Once built, the energy at ANY k-point comes from diagonalising a tiny matrix: meshes of 50³ points that would be impossible in DFT become free. It is what transport, fine Fermi surfaces and effective masses by finite differences need.
There is no need to install wannier90: Olla-DFT writes the .nnkp and does the projection and the minimisation itself.
strings.Transformar directamente las energías pr: Transforming the eigenvalues directly without a gauge. The phase a diagonaliser returns is arbitrary and changes from one k-point to the next, so what you transform is not smooth and the interpolation is off by a factor of 4.
strings.analizar y comparar con las bandas de DF: analyse and compare with the DFT bands
strings.¿es ferroeléctrico? ¿cuánta polarización: is it ferroelectric? how much polarization does it have?
strings.La polarización de un sólido periódico N:
The polarization of a periodic solid is NOT the integral of the dipole over the cell: that integral depends on where you put the edges. The observable is the Berry phase, and it is defined modulo a quantum.
Practical consequence: a lone value of P means nothing. You have to give the DIFFERENCE between the polar structure and a centrosymmetric reference, walking a path with small steps. The Born effective charges come from here too.
strings.Dar un valor de P de un solo cálculo. Es: Reporting a value of P from a single calculation. It is defined modulo the quantum, so on its own it is not publishable; and if the path has large steps, the branch tracking skips a whole quantum and the result still looks reasonable.
strings.camino adiabático de la referencia a la: adiabatic path from the reference to the polar structure
strings.cargas de Born desplazando un átomo: Born charges by displacing an atom
strings.¿conduce bien el calor? ¿me sirve para u: does it conduct heat well? is it any use for a thermoelectric?
strings.Los fonones armónicos no conducen calor:
Harmonic phonons do not conduct heat finitely: κ comes from the cubic term of the energy, the one that lets a phonon split in two. You need the fc3, which is expensive because it needs one derivative per TRIPLET of atoms.
Besides κ(T) you get the cumulative curve against the mean free path, which is what tells you whether nanostructuring lowers κ or not.
strings.Converger solo una cosa. κ tiene que con: Converging only one thing. κ has to converge in the supercell size AND in the q-mesh at the same time, and on top of that the RTA underestimates the result by 10 to 15 % in silicon.
strings.explorar con un potencial aprendido, par: explore with a machine-learned potential, to choose the supercell
strings.quiero una superficie cargada, o a un po: I want a charged surface, or one at a given potential
strings.superficies con medio de apantallamiento: surfaces with an effective screening medium (ESM)
strings.En una celda periódica normal, una super:
In a normal periodic cell, a CHARGED surface is computed with a uniform compensating background that fills all the vacuum. That background exists in no experiment and the energy you get converges to nothing.
ESM replaces the images along z with a boundary condition. With bc1 (neutral slab) the vacuum level is zero by construction, so the work function is directly −E_F, and a huge vacuum is no longer needed.
strings.Dejar la losa centrada donde la deja el: Leaving the slab centred where the structure builder leaves it. ESM measures z from the CENTRE of the cell: a slab at c/2 lands right on its boundary and the result is hundreds of Ry of error, with no message at all.
strings.función trabajo de la losa neutra: work function of the neutral slab
strings.barrido de carga con electrodo al otro l: charge sweep with an electrode on the other side
strings.¿sirve como catalizador para producir hi: is it any good as a catalyst for producing hydrogen or oxygen?
strings.Convierte energías de adsorción en un di:
Turns adsorption energies into a free-energy diagram against the applied potential, and from that come the limiting potential and the overpotential, which is the figure compared between catalysts.
The trick of the method is avoiding the solvated proton: H⁺ + e⁻ ⇌ ½H₂ at zero potential is used, which is exact by definition of the hydrogen electrode.
strings.Comparar energías de adsorción sin las c: Comparing adsorption energies without the thermal corrections (ZPE − TΔS). They are tenths of an eV and the same size as the differences under discussion.
strings.quiero un vidrio o un material amorfo, n: I want a glass or an amorphous material, not a crystal
strings.generación de estructuras amorfas por fu: generating amorphous structures by melt and quench
strings.Empaqueta los átomos a la densidad que l:
Packs the atoms at the density you ask for, melts them at high temperature and cools them down. With a machine-learned potential it takes minutes instead of days.
WATCH OUT for the quench rate: a real glass cools at 1-100 K/s and a simulation runs at 10¹²-10¹⁵ K/s. That is ten orders of magnitude, and the structure comes out more disordered and less dense than the real one.
strings.Quedarse con UNA realización. Un amorfo: Keeping ONE realisation. An amorphous material is not a structure, it is an ensemble: you have to generate several with different seeds and average.
strings.relajar con DFT antes de calcularle nada: relax with DFT before computing anything on it
strings.¿cómo sé que todo esto que he calculado: how do I know that everything I have computed is right?
strings.validación cruzada y contraste con la li: cross-validation and comparison with the literature
strings.Tres cosas distintas, y las tres hacen f:
Three different things, and all three are needed:
  · `selftest` checks the code itself against known values from the literature, each with its source.
  · `crosscheck` computes the same quantity by two independent routes and compares. Their agreement is the strongest evidence you can have without an experiment.
  · `doctor` and `audit` look at whether each calculation converged and whether two calculations are comparable with each other.
strings.Fiarse de que un cálculo terminó. Termin: Trusting that a calculation finished. Finishing and converging are not the same thing, and an scf that runs out of electron_maxstep writes JOB DONE all the same.
strings.validar el código contra la literatura: validate the code against the literature
strings.cruzar tus propios resultados por rutas: cross-check your own results by different routes
